title: Building a Church Unshakeable in Jesus Name
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he prays for a breakthrough in The River Church's membership, calling for stability, unity, and a deepening of roots in Jesus' name. He declares that this church will be filled with believers, Holy Ghost people, and committed members, and that it will have a lasting impact on the region. Listen as Pastor Zehner calls for a supernatural move of God to break out in this place.
